description: This file is a shell script used for testing git archive and related functionalities. It includes setup routines, test cases for tar and gzip handling, and validation checks for various git archive options and behaviors.

methods.name: get_pax_header
methods.description: Extracts a specific pax header value from a tar archive file.

methods.name: check_tar
methods.description: Validates tar archive extraction, pax headers, filenames, and file contents.

methods.name: check_added
methods.description: Checks that a file added to the archive matches expected content.

methods.name: check_mtime
methods.description: Validates that the modification time of a file in the archive matches expected.

methods.name: tar_info
methods.description: Uses system tar to extract size and date info for entries in a tar archive.
